title: in render fixtures, flag a next: hint for a pause kind that differs from what daemon pausedNext would give for that record

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-160126-bfbb, project ork, item S633:

in render fixtures, flag a next: hint for a pause kind that differs from what daemon pausedNext would give for that record

Evidence: the round 1 wait-block fixture showed "next: ork retry r1" on a question pause, which the reviewer missed and the UI pass caught
